image_description: A close-up portrait of a smiling woman wearing a dark blue velvet academic gown and a matching mortarboard cap with a gold tassel. The image is cropped at the chest, showing the upper torso and head against a black background.

The visible portion of the gown shows a clear vertical opening down the center front, consistent with academic regalia structure.
The fabric drapes loosely over the shoulders and chest, hiding the specific shape of the torso underneath.
